sampling.initial: schemagan3d.v3_eval_protocol.nested_sites(grid, entry.evaluation_site_seed + seed, valid, count); nested across counts
sampling.random_policy: SHA256(seed|realization_id|count|random) first 8 bytes big endian -> numpy.default_rng

candidate_validity: valid.any(z) and not observed.any(z) and access mask if supplied; lexicographic x,y; access mask all true for this synthetic evaluation
evaluation_mask: valid & ~(observed_after_hybrid | observed_after_uniform | observed_after_random); identical common hidden-valid voxels for each policy; exclude all selected CPT profiles
metrics: physical Ic per-case RMSE before/after, improvement=before-after; arithmetic mean of per-case values; valid, duplicate, no-candidate rates
confidence_interval: paired delta Hybrid minus comparator, first average seven CPT deltas per realization ID, then 2000 volume-level percentile bootstrap resamples; seed 1000014; for CPT/grid/family breakdown resample realization IDs in stratum
development_reference: existing validation_id 300-volume records; different masks may limit numeric comparability
stop_criteria: Stop and mark FINAL_EVALUATION_FAILED on missing split, split overlap, empty common mask, identity mismatch, nonfinite metric, illegal/duplicate action, or failed test. Do not replace split or tune routing.
test_independence_limit: test splits previously used for SchemaGAN evaluation; independent only relative to DQN model selection
